label: Bible Study
prompt: But the _____ of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, longsuffering, gentleness, goodness, faith,
verse: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, longsuffering, gentleness, goodness, faith,
note: Fruit, singular — one crop with nine flavors.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Seek ye the LORD while he may be found, call ye upon him while he is _____:
verse: Seek ye the LORD while he may be found, call ye upon him while he is near:
note: The invitation has a window — 'while he is near' — and mercifully, near is where He stays.

label: Sunday School
prompt: Behold, I will put a fleece of wool in the floor; and if the _____ be on the fleece only, and it be dry upon all the earth beside, then shall I know that thou wilt save Israel by mine hand, as thou hast said.
verse: Behold, I will put a fleece of wool in the floor; and if the dew be on the fleece only, and it be dry upon all the earth beside, then shall I know that thou wilt save Israel by mine hand, as thou hast said.
note: Gideon's famous fleece test: dew on the wool, dry ground everywhere else — sign requested, sign granted.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Let your speech be alway with grace, seasoned with _____, that ye may know how ye ought to answer every man.
verse: Let your speech be alway with grace, seasoned with salt, that ye may know how ye ought to answer every man.
note: Paul's recipe for conversation: grace as the base, salt for savor — words that preserve, not sting.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: In a moment, in the _____ of an eye, at the last trump: for the trumpet shall sound, and the dead shall be raised incorruptible, and we shall be changed.
verse: In a moment, in the twinkling of an eye, at the last trump: for the trumpet shall sound, and the dead shall be raised incorruptible, and we shall be changed.
note: Not the twinkle itself — the 'twinkling,' the split second an eye takes to glint. Resurrection speed.
